technique_name: Provide some advice for a student wanting to learn Mandarin.
description: If you are interested in learning Mandarin, attending classes or using online study materials can help you get started. The key to mastering Mandarin is frequent and consistent practice. Learning the language requires patience, but you'll reap the rewards of being able to communicate with Chinese speakers all over the world.
